spans.s:
ind.
An unmeaning word in the dialect of the demons or Piśācas, when they are introduced in plays, &c. also अलले.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Much, large.
adv. n. (-शं)
Not at all.
E.
अ neg. लेश small.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Firm, steady.
E.
अलेश not at all, एज what shakes.

Painting.
f. (-नी)
A brush, a pencil.
E.
आङ् before लिख to write, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं)
1 To be written.
2 To be delineated or painted.
n. (-ख्यं)
1 A painting.
2 A writing.
E.
आङ् before लिख to write, ण्यत् aff.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
Dead, deceased.
E.
आलेख्य painting. writing, and शेष final.

m. (-पः)
1 Smearing, plastering, anointing.
2 Liniment.
E.
आङ् before लिपि to anoint, घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Smearing, plastering.
2 Liniment.
E.
आङ्, before लिप to smear, ल्युट् aff.
